NOTIFY_SUBTITLE: Show a toast when a scheduled message goes out.
DEFAULT_DELAY_SUBTITLE: Used by the schedule button when you give no time.
LIMIT_SUBTITLE: The most messages that can wait at once.
LATER_DESC: Send a message at a time you choose
WHEN_DESC: A delay such as 2h, a clock time such as 18:30, or a date such as 2026-12-24 18:00
BAD_WHEN: "{when}" is not a time Unbound understands.
QUEUE_FULL: You already have {limit} messages waiting. Cancel one with /laters first.
LATERS_DESC: List, or cancel, your scheduled messages
CANCEL_DESC: The number of a message to cancel
SEND_FAILED: Failed to send the scheduled message in {channel}.
